get.x-resource-check: Interactive human identity; own user and organization only. PATs cannot manage tokens or human-only actions.
get.description: Password browser session uses HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; mutations require allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Password-only sessions cannot use production or release approval. Registration uses a valid one-use invitation, or an organization that currently allows direct registration. Organization policy is locked and rechecked inside the registration transaction. Direct registration creates a fixed business developer role; clients cannot choose roles or privileges. No public admin bootstrap. Password and cookie never enter logs; all responses no-store. First-login password change enforced by server. Invitation secret returned once, never replayed.
